title: Decoded #16: The Six-Week Pilot That Proved Nothing

caption:
Decoded by Galvor, Issue #16: The Six-Week Pilot That Proved Nothing

Pilots are how D2C brands buy anything new in marketing, and most of them end the same way: good feelings, a deck, and no decision. This issue opens proof season with what a creative pilot should measure, what counts as a result, and the questions to settle before day one, whoever the vendor is.

Subscribe to get it every Wednesday.
notes: Outline planned 18 Nov 2026 (why now: February is when brands decide which Q4 and January pilots to renew before the new financial year; opens Galvor's Feb 'Proof season' theme and sets up the client stories in #17 and #19.).
